guidelines: Use the existing closure receipt and cleanup ordering; do not create a force-delete escape hatch.
Keep the source-of-truth override explicit and scoped to archived evidence validation.

intent.problem: After PR #916 repaired source-bound Implementation Knowledge projections on the synchronized main branch, the already-merged #915 Work Item could not be closed because ai-close-work-item checked the archived projection against the pre-repair #915 branch snapshot before synchronizing main. The closure command therefore blocked a safe cleanup even though current base truth was valid.
constraints: Preserve the merged PR's exact Head SHA and branch identity checks.
Do not rewrite historical archived evidence or bypass fail-closed cleanup.
Delete local and remote Work Item branches only after evidence, synchronization, receipt, and postconditions pass.
intent.rationale: Closure is a repository-state operation. Once the PR identity is proven, current archived evidence and generated projections must be checked against the synchronized base snapshot that will remain after branch cleanup, not against an obsolete source snapshot that cannot be updated without changing the PR Head SHA.
